Class DiscordApp

java.lang.Object
com.github.pinont.singularitylib.api.hook.discordJDA.DiscordApp
public abstract class DiscordApp extends Object
Abstract base class for Discord bot applications using JDA (Java Discord API). Provides a framework for creating Discord bots with slash command support and configuration management.

    • reloadConfig

      public void reloadConfig()

    • start

      public final void start()
      Starts the Discord bot with the configured settings. If multi-threading is enabled, the bot will run in a separate thread.

    • shutdown

      public final void shutdown()
      Shuts down the Discord bot and cleans up resources. If running in multi-threaded mode, waits for the thread to complete.
